primary_quantity.name: d_h_bottom_d_q_bottom
primary_quantity.definition: Derivative of the lower endpoint pressure head h_bottom with respect to prescribed lower boundary Darcy flux q_bottom for the frozen homogeneous Ross face chain at fixed top pressure head.
primary_quantity.flux_sign: positive downward, matching the C1R steady_q/table-face convention

discrete_system.faces: N serial 10 cm C1R faces with fixed h_0 and unknown h_1..h_N
discrete_system.jacobian: tridiagonal from the qualified closed-form C1R endpoint face derivatives
discrete_system.production_incremental_cost: reuse one factorization already available for the normal frozen-regime solve and perform exactly one additional tangent backsolve

qualification_cases.base_profile_generation: qualification-only independent scalar root solution of each frozen table face q_i=q_bottom, not part of production tangent cost

finite_difference_precommit.oracle: independently regenerate complete plus and minus table-law profiles for q_bottom +/- delta_q; never use analytic face derivatives inside the FD profile generator

mass_and_noninterference.mass_proxy: steady serial-face continuity, all face fluxes equal q_bottom within the hard residual gate
mass_and_noninterference.tangent_is_diagnostic_only: normal correction and tangent vectors are scratch and are not committed
base profile and shared table must remain bitwise unchanged

smooth_regime_policy: all base and FD endpoint heads must remain strict C1R interpolation-cell interiors
any table-cell transition in plus/minus FD fails this gate and is classified as regime switching rather than silently averaged

exit_rule.fail: Keep J1 incomplete and classify derivative representation, discrete algebra, FD oracle or regime switching from recorded diagnostics.

scope_guards: No Class-B H_ENPR, KSATEXM, saturation, heterogeneity, groundwater switching, crop/process physics or production admission.
